hindi: मिलनसार, लोगों के साथ रहना पसंद करने वाला
definition: fond of the company of others; sociable
example: She was a gregarious, outgoing woman who loved parties.

hindi: बारीकियों पर बहुत ध्यान देने वाला, सूक्ष्म
definition: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
example: He kept meticulous records of every expense.

definition: not friendly or forthcoming; cool and distant
example: He remained aloof from the rest of the group.

definition: holding firmly to a purpose; persistent and determined
example: Her tenacious spirit carried her through the setbacks.

definition: friendly, good-natured, and easy to talk to
example: The affable host made every guest feel welcome.

definition: stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action
example: He was too obstinate to admit he was wrong.

definition: truthful and straightforward; frank
example: She gave a candid account of her mistakes.

definition: having or showing care and steady effort in one's work
example: A diligent student, she never missed an assignment.

definition: childishly sulky or bad-tempered
example: He gave a petulant shrug and stormed off.

definition: generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or less powerful person
example: In victory she was magnanimous, praising her opponent.

definition: not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily
example: He was reticent about his private life.

hindi: भोला, आसानी से बहकाया जाने वाला
definition: easily persuaded to believe something; credulous
example: The scam preyed on gullible investors.

definition: wishing to do one's work well and thoroughly
example: A conscientious worker, he double-checked every figure.

hindi: आवेगपूर्ण, बिना सोचे-समझे काम करने वाला
definition: acting or done quickly and without thought or care
example: His impetuous decision cost him the job.

definition: having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner
example: Their amiable neighbor always waved hello.

hindi: निंदक, हर चीज़ में स्वार्थ देखने वाला
definition: believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest; distrustful
example: She had a cynical view of politicians' promises.

definition: courteous, kind, and pleasant, especially toward those of lower status
example: He was gracious in defeat.

definition: arrogantly superior and disdainful
example: She gave a haughty toss of her head.

definition: able to recover quickly from difficulties; tough
example: Children are often remarkably resilient.

definition: dealing with things sensibly and realistically
example: She took a pragmatic approach to the budget cuts.
